narr: Abundant moisture over northern Arizona allowed strong thunderstorms with heavy rain and rotation to form across the area.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding from Washington Park to Tonto Village. Water was cascading through yards and flooding roadways. The East Verde River rose 3 feet near Washington Park at 540 PM MST.
lsr: WATER CASCADING THROUGH YARD. 1.10 INCHES MEASURED IN 40 MINUTES.
4 FOOT RISE ON THE EAST VERDE RIVER.
